column2: Maximum number of UL-SCH transport block bits transmitted within a TTI
column3: Maximum number of bits of an UL-SCH transport block transmitted within a TTI

column1: NOTE 1:The UE supports "Maximum number of UL-SCH transport block bits transmitted within a TTI" and "Maximum number of bits of an UL-SCH transport block transmitted within a TTI" of 2984 bits if the UE indicates support of ce-PUSCH-NB-MaxTBS-r14. Otherwise the UE supports 1000 bits.
